notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes - 26th September 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Demo V0.1b - 26-09-23[/h1]
[list]
[*] Streamlined the whole tutorial - it is much quicker and less frustrating now with no more pausing and stop/starting. Players can now technically speedrun the entirety of the tutorial in under 2 mins if you like!
[*] The CPD level introduction video is now skippable.
[*] Audio settings now work within the tutorial - there was a bug that stopped this from working. We are aware of a different bug where sound settings do not save when abandoning the tutorial. This will be addressed in the next patch.
[*] Fixed a bug in the CPD level where the narrator would repeat the line when you retried a mission.
[*] Fixed a bug in the CPD where the narrator would continue to talk after completing a mission.
[*] Added some more visual cues in the tutorial relating to the click and drag system for orienting and scaling members.
[*] Changed the building guide/UI to highlight the keys pressed, so people can directly see what button does what on the left hand side of the screen.
[*] Added the ability to toggle the camera system to move directly in the direction of travel, including upwards. This is toggled in the settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes - 19th September 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Next Fest Demo - Update - 19-09-23[/h1]

[h2]Overall Game Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Minor geometry tweaks to a couple of CPD missions to improve building experience.
[*] Updated wording in the “Build Fence" mission wording to make it clearer. 
[/list]
[h2]Building[/h2]
[list]
[*] Limited the length of placeholder bracing and sheets 3D model to highlight their maximum length. This will now make it clear why they are unable to place the object (i.e. it’s too short or too long).
[*] Created a brand new optional and toggleable “Advanced Enjeniring” mode which changes how clashing members are dealt with. As default now, players will be unable to place clashing members, which now minimises structural failure or physics explosion due to clashes. Enabling “Advanced Enjeniring” mode in the settings, will allow you to place clashing members, for people who like to live a little more dangerously, and know what clashes are acceptable and which aren’t. Only veteran Enjenirs should use “Advanced Enjeniring” mode
[*] “Fixed connections” are now equipped by default, instead of “free connections”.
[*] Tutorial updated to explain the new building mode which requires the player clicking and dragging left and right in order to scale or rotate members. This system is better than using the scroll wheel for scaling and rotating, however we notice players still using the scroll wheel instead, so we are trying to communicate the new clicking and dragging left and right. We will be adding specific narrator/voice over lines in the next patch to clarify even further.
[*] New nail placement system which allows you to see through a member while placing a nail, by making the member semi-transparent. This will make it easier to align nails. 
[*] The building mode now has a toggleable “Light” key, which enables you to turn on and off the light while building. Certain situations arise where the lighting is too bright when building up close in certain angles, so now you can manually turn on and off the light.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes - 17th September 2023
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

[h2]Overall Game Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] This patch reduces the build to just the NextFest demo content. This means Tutorial - CPD Level and Farmers Level.

[*] First time booting the game will give you Language and Keyboard Layout options. These can be changed in the settings. English is the only language currently supported.

[*] New splash screen (company logo) and intro text (welcome message) added when you boot or restart the game.

[*] Massively expanded the general settings and graphic settings available in game.

[*] Keybinding is now fully functional.
[*] 
[*] Settings are accessible in game and not just at the main menu.

[*] On the home screen we have added links to the Discord, Wishlisting on Steam, and a Survey Page for feedback (we have yet to add the actual survey in there).

[*] We’ve removed the Beta Testing watermark including the computer name and FPS counter. We have switched this 
[/list]

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tutorial has been expanded with explanations for new mechanics, including the building system and ropes.

[*] Tutorial audio volume levels have been tweaked to be made more consistent.

[*] Third person character UI has been revamped.
[/list]


[h2]Building[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have completely revamped and expanded the advanced controls for the building for scaling and rotating items, which allows a lot more control to precision when placing the item. To rotate an item in the Z axis, you can simply click (hold) and drag while placing the item to freely rotate it on the spot. If you hold the “Rotate X” or “Rotate Y” keys (default = Left Shift and Left Alt) you will control the rotation in those axis - again with the dragging of your mouse. Similarly, while placing an item, if you click (hold) and hold the “Scale Key” (default capslock) you will control the scale of the item using the dragging of your mouse. Things like offsetting of items (like sheets) still use the scroll wheel, since you are already clicking (hold) and dragging to place the sheet. This new system is a massive improvement across the board, but might take a little getting used to if you are already super accustomed to the older scroll wheel system.

[*] The older/legacy system which just uses the scroll wheel is actually still in place and can still be used. 

[*] UI and Icons have been updated - two (propeller and rotating joint) are currently still placeholders.
[/list]

[h2]Character:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Third person character controls have been tweaked and improved in a number of small ways.

[*] Character is more stable now when running, walking and standing. His feet don’t get “caught” under him as much. This does still happen when turning tight corners while walking/running sometimes, but overall he is a lot more stable.

[*] Tutorial Prompts and in game Guide for UI has been completely revamped, and factors in the new rebindable settings. So any changes to your keybindings dynamically update the guides.

[*] Climbing has been optimised to make it simpler. When you are climbing now (holding the “Climb” button) your hands automatically reach out. This makes it simpler to climb, where you just hold “climb” (by default the spacebar) and just alternate clicks to grab with your left and right hand. No longer any need to hold Reach Left and Reach Right (Q and E) while climbing.

[*] The third person character has been made controller friendly - so in theory if you have a controller plugged in, he should just work. This should automatically update the keybindings on the guide/tutorial too, however the controller keybindings are placeholder and very ‘texty’. Our aim is to replace these with controller button icons instead of the text describing the keys.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes - 8th July 2023
notes.content:
[b]Overall Update:[/b]

This game comes with a full game reset - all saves will be wiped and players will be required to try out the tutorial including the new CPD level.

Added a new introductory level called CPD, which is played after the tutorial. This level includes 6 simple missions to help ease players into the game mechanics.

[b]Creative Mode Updates:[/b]

Added multiple save slots specifically for the Creative Mode.

Removed Mission List from Creative Mode

[b]Building Updates:[/b]

Fixed the massive performance issue linked to the nails which was causing massive frame drops or larger builds, or builds with lots of nails.

Added nodes to construction lines. Nodes are created at intersections of construction lines. You can build off of these nodes.

Fixed the mission related bug where structures would not reappear after going back to the drawing board. 

Fixed the leaky boat bug where the boat was hitting a collider in the distance.

Fixed the Build a Bridge bug where the mission would prematurely end for no reason.
Removed Barn Mission from Farm Level and replaced with easier mission.

Made bridge level in Seaside Levell easier.

"Connection Type" label applied to Free/Fixed connections in the building hotbar.

Removed the requirement for a fixed connection to connect a beam or log to a rotating joint

It is now possible to attach bracing to rotating joints.

Added a notification that tells you when you've unlocked the next level.

Added a timer result to the scoreboard of each mission

Changed the exposure levels and fixed a bug which reduce whiteness and improve visual quality in building mode.


[b]Third Person Character Update:[/b]

Updated performance and accuracy of physics collision calculations in hands and feet (not linked to the control) of the third person character.

Updated starting position of hands when reaching out, making it (theoretically) easier for new players to climb.

Adjust climbing forces to improve body position when climbing.

Fixed the bug where the character would be unable to walk at the start of a mission.

Fixed the bug where the character would just collapse at the start of a mission.

Character hands are now breakable, eliminating the physics bug where you grab onto an animated mesh with one hand and a static mesh with the other.

Improved collision responses for triggering events.

Fixed bug where character would behave as if sprinting (shift down) when the shift key was not pressed.

Updated signs in tutorial to improve performance and make the controls clearer.

[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes - 25th June 2023
notes.content:
[u][b]Playtest instructions if you've already tested the game:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Replay the tutorial (new changes, bug fixes and narration added)
[*] Start a "New Game" slot, and ignore the new visual bug on the level selection screen which says you've already completed lots of missions when you haven’t (in this new saved). We're already aware of this bug and are already fixing it.
[*] We have identified a bug in the main menu where the music doubles up for some people. It's just in the main menu so bear with it for now and it'll be patched in the next update!
[/list]


[u][b]General Updates:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Tutorial Voiceover added
[*] Number of random tutorial bugs fixed
[*] Added more signposts in the third person tutorial to provide clearer instructions 
[*] New missions added in game throughout all levels
[*] Incorporated NPC pictures into mission descriptions for context
[*] Made missions harder to cheat (sorry Donald lol)
[*] Clarified that the settings menu (including keybinds etc) are all placeholder with no functionality (other than music control)
[*] Overhauled weight system of building materials. Members weigh more depending on their size, instead of fixed weight per member type.
[*] Overhauled the points/scoring system for completing missions. Compensation is now money only.
[*] Overhauled the mission completion screen, with an advanced breakdown of materials used.
[*] Music levels decreased
[/list]

[u][b]Building Mode Specific Updates:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added a toggleable building guide / control guide on left of screen informing the player of which buttons / controls do what (rotation, scaling, offset etc) specific to each member.
[*] Added the option to "refine" designs even after successfully completing a mission
[*] Camera control system updated. Camera remains at the same level/altitude when using WASD, and will only go downwards or upwards with Q and E.
[*] The Wheel, Rotating Joint, and Enjenir placement system has changed. Instead of usingall  rotation changes: rotating wheels and the Enjenir along the Z axis no longer use CTRL + scroll wheel to rotate. New system requires you to click, hold and drag left or right to rotate, release click to place. Middle mouse wheel will abort placement.
[*] Cursor no longer moves when panning.
[*] Clash detection improved with large rotating members 
[*] Clash detection improved no longer clashing with nails
[*] When placing a sheet, holding shift will prevent the sheet from snapping to a surface and will just project it outwards, with the projected end not needing to be attached to anything.
[/list]

[u][b]Third Person Character Specific Updates:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Overhauled the UI guide in tutorial (and toggleable in game) showing which buttons do what for the Third Person Character)
[*] Autowalk option added. Now you can autowalk with W (forward) and S (backwards). Holding shift sprints. Precision walking/running is still available with A and D.
[*] General Climbing improvements added across the board.
[*] Fixed bug when climbing up and over a wall which made it difficult to pull yourself up and over the edge. When climbing, aiming downwards will now pull yourself forward over edges more effectively.
[*] Overhaul of character weight distributions
[*] Fixed end of mission / start of mission bug where character continued walking from one mission to the next
[/list]
